The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Formation and Continued Activity (1993-Present)
podcast.body: Gobb was formed in Langley, BC, in 1993 and remains active today, though with some adjustments to their lineup over the years. "Gobb, a fine band formed in Langley, BC, and 1993. They're still going, albeit with a few adjustments on the way."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Bass Player Changes (2004)
podcast.body: In 2004, Craig Wood, the band's bass player, left to join Avril Lavigne's band for a few years before settling down in Winnipeg. He was replaced by Steve Fairweather, who remains with Gobb as their current bassist. "In 2004, there was a change in bass player when Craig Wood joined Avril Lavigne's band. That lasted for a few years before he settled down with a family in Winnipeg. His replacement, Steve Fairweather, is still with the group."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Extensive Discography and Juno Nominations
podcast.body: The band has released six studio albums, all under the Network label, and has received a couple of Juno nominations throughout their career. "Six studio albums, all with the network label. [...] and there were a couple of June nominations."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Extensive Touring and Warped Tour Presence
podcast.body: The band has toured extensively and was a regular fixture on the popular Warped Tour, indicating their significant live performance history. "They've toured a lot, and they were a fixture on the band's warp tour."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Video Game Music Appearances
podcast.body: Gobb's music has been featured in a number of video games, including titles for the NHL and John Madden's NFL 2004, showcasing their reach beyond traditional music platforms. "Their songs have been in a bunch of video games, including one for the NHL and John Madden's NFL 2004."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
